verdict.rationale: Reducto is a document-processing API with a CLI and MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The pack only documents a Zero Data Retention policy for submitted documents and deployment options; that is data retention, an adjacent control, not an opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking. No evidence shows such a setting in the API, CLI, Studio or MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
